design_concept: Ultra-minimalist, high-performance, stealth/utility directory inspired by club44.cc. Zero bloat, no logo, pure functional typography and stark contrast. It acts as a fast-access software bypass/download hub.

layout_strategy.spacing: Dense but clear. p-6 inside cards. gap-4 or gap-6 for grids.
layout_strategy.corners: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px) to maintain a brutalist/technical edge.
layout_strategy.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 everywhere instead of shadows.

animations.hover: Instant or very fast (duration-150). No bouncy scales. Borders light up to border-white/40.
animations.buttons: Invert colors on hover (bg-white text-black -> bg-black text-white border border-white).

components.header: No logo. Just a clean structural top bar. Perhaps a text 'INDEX' or nothing at all, just search and categories.
components.search_bar: Massive, screen-wide or container-wide input. border-b border-white/20, bg-transparent, text-2xl focus:outline-none focus:border-white text-white p-4. Placeholder text muted.
components.category_tabs: Clean text links with brackets [ All ] [ Social Media ] [ Gaming ] [ Other ] for an edgy tech vibe.
components.app_card: Minimalist rectangular block. Contains App Icon (top left), Title (mono or sans), Category label, short description, and a high-contrast 'Download' button at the bottom.
components.floating_info_btn: Fixed bottom-right position. Small circular or square button (e.g., 'i' or '?' icon), pure white bg, black text. Opens a Shadcn Sheet or Dialog.
components.info_sheet: A neat, organized list of all apps, their full descriptions, and secondary download links.
components.admin_panel: Dense data table layout. High contrast rows. Columns: App Name, Category, URL, and Download Count. Includes 'Add App' modal.

pages.home: Hero contains the massive search bar and category filters. Below is the grid of apps. Floating info button bottom right.
pages.admin: Accessible via a hidden route (e.g., /admin). Clean dashboard layout with a table.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React application with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI. Ensure the aesthetic is ultra-dark, minimalist, and brutalist. Avoid unnecessary shadows; use 1px borders for structure.
Do NOT add a brand logo to the site header as requested by the user.
Run `yarn add react-icons` to get the brand icons (SiDiscord, SiSteam, etc.) needed for the apps.
Store the `data_seed` array in a global state or a local context so that the Admin Panel can modify it and track 'download_count' for each app.
On the Home Page, include a search input and category filters (Social Media, Gaming, Other).
Create a Floating Action Button (FAB) at the bottom right. Clicking it should open a Modal or Sheet showing all apps with descriptions.
When a user clicks 'Download' on an app card, open the URL in a new tab AND increment that app's download counter in the state.
Create an Admin Panel route (e.g., `/admin`) with a Table to view apps, their download counters, and a form to add new apps.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="download-button-discord"`, `data-testid="search-input"`).
Focus on high performance: avoid heavy libraries, use basic CSS transitions, and keep the DOM clean.
